title: Singapore Airlines Goes All In On Luxury, Europe's Bomb Hoax Headache, and KLM's Layoffs Keep Growing
summary: Singapore Airlines just dropped its biggest cabin redesign in a decade — complete with a double bed in first class and a theme song performed by flight crew. Plus, a fresh wave of bomb hoaxes disrupts flights across Europe for the second day running, KLM piles on another thousand job cuts, Southwest can't find the on-time gate, and Emirates somehow turns a profit in the middle of a war zone.
